text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—My preparations are complete.
I am ready to race at a moment's notice.
choice_data_list: Shall we be on our way, Lady Rose?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...However, your 'favor' is simply
'competing in today's mock race'...
is that truly all?

Yes, I nodded back without a shred of
hesitation.
choice_data_list: Here, I shall convey my resolve to...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
In that case,
all I must do is run with everything I
have.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With today's lineup, after all,
there won't be the slightest opening
allowed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's packed!
There are even reporters scattered about.
Well, to be fair,
this mock race is definitely not one to
miss.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Right?! After all—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The next generation's rising stars are all
gathered here!
I can't help but wonder which one has what
it takes to shoulder the future.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, here she comes...
Rose Kingdom of the House of Roses!
Does she possess the caliber to fulfill
their long-cherished ambition...? Now,
it's about to begin.

And so,
Rose Kingdom and the others solemnly headed
toward the gate—
and the fateful mock race began.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... The pace has not slackened.
The race is developing just as
anticipated.
—Good. I shall continue marking Pisa.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It seems the tactics we prepared are identical,
Rose. Heh...
but it's all within my calculations!
This race is already in the palm of my
hand!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Rose Kingdom and Rulership are right on
Victoire Pisa's heels!
It looks like this will come down to a duel
of closing speed between these three!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I have shaken off both Ruler and Pisa.
I can do this—I can win!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Das ist meine Chance! Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Wha...!? Flash-senpai,
you still have this much left in your
legs!?
...Ngh...—Can I keep up...!?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Just a little more!
Victory is right there—)

—Just a little more.
—Just one step closer.
—Yet out of reach. —Yet I cannot reach it.

The thorns...
are winding around me once more—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Fool! What am I thinking?!
No, right now—curse it,
these stray thoughts—...!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: Victory! —I believe in you, Lady R...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Indeed. ...That was it.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(We, the Clan of the Roses,
share a dream of founding a kingdom.
And through it all,
there have always—
always been comrades standing by us.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(An alliance so steadfast and gentle is
precisely what I...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I found it more precious...
and more endearing than anything else—)
choice_data_list: Give it your all!! Lady Roseeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. ...Heh, haha—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I see. These are your feelings.
Your will.
Indeed, what reason have I to doubt?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (For right now! Within my legs lies—!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Having received your feelings,
this is how much...!
How overflowing with strength I have
become—!)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ―――HAAAAAAAHHHH!!!!

And so,
in splendid fashion...
Rose Kingdom claimed victory in the mock
race.

Enveloped in cheers,
she was nearly mobbed by the press—
but before they could reach her,
she walked straight ahead.

She had simply returned straight back to my
side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...In that dire moment, your voice,
your heartfelt feelings reached me.
They gave me strength.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Trainer.
Will you remain by my side from now on?
Will you carry this grand ambition...
together with me?
And several days later—

text_block_list.name: Vending Machine Voice
text_block_list.text:
“Insert coins,
then press the number of the item you
want!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I desire item number 10,
yet the panel appears to only go up to 9.
How might one purchase number 10? Pray,
enlighten me.

text_block_list.name: Vending Machine Voice
text_block_list.text:
“Insert coins,
then press the number of the item you
want!”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I inserted the payment a moment ago. Please,
answer my question—
Ah, no,
did I neglect to include a tip?
Forgive my terrible discourtesy.
choice_data_list: L-Lady Rose? Um, I have returned, ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see,
so there is not a concierge inside.
My apologies;
I remain quite unfamiliar with the common
knowledge of everyday folk.
choice_data_list: No... Shall I go buy something to ...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No. ...I intended to offer it to you.
You appeared quite tense, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry.
Tonight is merely an intimate gathering of
kin.
...And that is precisely why I invited
you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hold your head high.
That new formal attire suits you well,
too.
Beside me—none could be more fitting.

Holding those precious,
almost undeserved words close to my heart—
I earnestly straightened my posture alongside
Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
Rose.
I heard you would be taking your vows
today.
Together with him... your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
Rose.
I heard you would be taking your vows
today.
Together with her... your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—Now, Trainer, come to my side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Mother. Everyone. ...I give you my vow.
Together with him, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Mother. Everyone. ...I give you my vow.
Together with her, I shall—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall build an eternal Rose Kingdom for
all to see.
